competitors.name: Amazon Grocery
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Amazon has retrofitted Same-Day facilities with ambient, cooled and frozen zones for perishable grocery delivery, with more retrofits planned. Amazon said monthly active perishables customers are up more than 50% since the start of the year, perishable Same-Day orders average more than 3x the units of nonperishable Same-Day orders, and frozen pizza is one example of items picked from the frozen zone.

competitors.name: Barilla Group / GOODLES
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Barilla Group will acquire better-for-you mac and cheese brand GOODLES, which will remain a standalone brand with its Santa Cruz headquarters, recipes, ingredients, suppliers and marketing unchanged. GOODLES said it added about 2 million new customers in the last 90 days while more than 90% of U.S. consumers have not yet tried its products.

competitors.name: In-store bakery retailers
competitors.action: Supermarket News reported in-store bakery merchandising is becoming more complex as retailers balance product mix, displays, packaging and pricing. FMI's bakery report framed value as a combination of price, quality, convenience, relevance and experience, while merchandising advisors warned that over-assortment, plastic glare and clearance-heavy displays can reduce shopper appeal.

trends.topic: Same-day grocery is moving deeper into frozen and perishable execution
trends.magnitude: Amazon said monthly active perishables customers grew more than 50% since the start of the year and perishable Same-Day orders average over 3x more units than nonperishable Same-Day orders.
trends.context: Frozen pizza brands need marketplace-ready item data, cold-chain reliability and assortment logic as same-day grocery platforms become a more credible route for frozen and fresh baskets.

trends.topic: Scaled CPGs acquiring better-for-you challenger brands
trends.magnitude: GOODLES reported about 2 million new customers in the last 90 days ahead of Barilla's planned acquisition.
trends.context: Large food companies continue using acquisitions to add younger, better-for-you brands rather than relying only on internal renovation.

trends.topic: Bakery value is being defined beyond price
trends.magnitude: FMI framed in-store bakery value as price plus quality, convenience, relevance and experience.
trends.context: Artisan and sourdough-positioned products still need clear visual merchandising and value cues; premium alone is not enough if displays create friction or blur.
